The '''Stalbringion hells''', also known as the '''Stalbringion damnation''', was a mythological place of suffering and horror.<ref name="swcw">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref> It was sometimes used as an expletive for emphasis after an interrogative term.<ref name="LSSM">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>
